scientific_integrity: The sign classification is analytically proved. Finite rational checks and path simulations are supporting diagnostics only; no independent scientific or publication-priority validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary two-dimensional harmonic active Brownian particle; positive trap relaxation, rotational diffusion, translational diffusivity, propulsion, and Poisson full-reset rate; common resets to fixed position and heading. No partial/reset-angle randomization, chirality, interactions, nonharmonic traps, or non-Poisson protocols. A sign change can be exponentially small in amplitude.
title: A sharp longitudinal anticorrelation threshold for a completely reset active Brownian particle
